title: MduX Justification
description: Links a design decision to a specific standard's clause, in original prose, with the concrete repository mechanism that addresses the clause's intent. See docs/governance/citation-convention.md for the rule this schema formalizes: a Justification with no real evidence_refs is decorative, not load-bearing, and mdux-docs-lint treats it as an error rather than as valid metadata.

justification_id.description: Unique across the whole corpus, not just within one standard's documents.

standard.description: One of the five standards MduX cites against. Closed set, matching docs/governance/citation-convention.md's approved identifiers exactly.

clause_ref.description: The citation-key format from docs/governance/citation-convention.md: '<Standard> §<clause> <Short clause title>'. Must start with the same value as `standard` - enforced below by the per-standard if/then pairs, since a plain pattern here cannot cross-reference a sibling property.

rationale.description: Original prose explaining why the cited mechanism satisfies the clause's intent. Never a quotation or close paraphrase of the standard's own wording (ADR-006) - mdux-docs-lint's reproduction heuristic runs over this field along with everything else in the corpus.

requirement_id.description: Optional link to a tracked requirement, when one exists independently of this justification.

evidence_refs.description: Repository-relative paths to the concrete mechanism - a module, an ADR, a CI step, a test - that addresses the clause's intent. Never empty: a Justification with no evidence is exactly the 'decorative citation' the citation convention rejects.
